svg.title: Fluixy.ai: AI app builder for Indian users
svg.desc: Animated card. A prompt is typed into a chat bar; Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic and Bedrock connect through one GraphQL API whose stream assembles an app, with rupee prices, a +91 phone field and a DD/MM/YYYY date, in a browser frame. Built with TypeScript, Remix, Go, GraphQL and Cloudflare.
